title: ChatGPT Can't Sell (And That's Probably a Good Thing): Buyer-Aligned AI Advice, the Sales-Representative Gap, and Evidence from Commercial Conversations
abstract: arXiv:2611.28946v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI assistants and merchant sales agents have different objectives: assistants should help buyers compare options and preserve the choice not to purchase, while sales agents also guide qualified buyers toward an authorized next step. We study this sales-representative gap with three evidence streams. In 12,178 historical English GPT-family conversations screened for commercial or transactional intent, a 279-request sample contained recommendation language in 63 first replies (22.6%) and no narrow transactional action wording. In a 56-conversation explicit-buying sample, 24 replies (42.9%) contained recommendation markers, 32 (57.1%) qualification phrases, and none transaction-specific phrases. These lexical measures do not estimate successful selling. translated_title: 《ChatGPT无法销售（而这或许是件好事）：面向买家的AI建议、销售代表差距及来自商业对话的证据》
translated_abstract: AI助手和商家销售代理有着不同的目标：助手应当帮助买家比较各种选项，并保留不购买的选择权；而销售代理还会引导符合条件的买家迈向经授权的下一步行动。我们通过三个证据流来研究这种“销售代表差距”。在12,178条经过商业或交易意图筛选的历史英文GPT系列对话中，一个279个请求的样本里有63条首次回复（22.6%）包含推荐语言，且没有任何狭义的交易行动措辞。在一个包含56段对话的明确购买样本中，24条回复（42.9%）包含推荐标记，32条（57.1%）包含资格甄别短语，而没有一条包含交易特定短语。这些词汇层面的度量并不能估算实际的销售成功率。一项2026年品牌监测队列研究对1,050对GPT-5.4与Gemini的回答在383个购买相关提示上进行了分析，结果显示：在措辞为推荐的提示中，交易特定短语的出现率为0.0%，在……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过三类大规模商业对话证据表明，ChatGPT等AI助手在购买情境中只提供推荐和购买资格甄别建议，而不会执行真正的交易促进行动，作者认为这种与买家立场一致、无法代商家完成销售的特性可能是件好事。
en_tdlr: Using three evidence streams from commercial conversations, this study shows that AI assistants like ChatGPT provide buyer-aligned advice and qualification language but do not perform transaction-specific selling actions, arguing that this sales-representative gap is probably a good thing.
